gloss: to soak in water; to immerse in water

definitions.gloss: to soak in water; to immerse in water
definitions.explanation: To place something in water and leave it submerged, typically for cleaning, softening, or preparation purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{水|みず}に{浸|ひた}す。
⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧{水|みず}に{浸|ひた}しておく。
examples.english: To soak beans in water overnight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧⟦わかめ→わかめ：10654_wakame⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{水|みず}に{浸|ひた}して⟦{戻|もど}して→戻す：02317_modosu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Soak the dried wakame in water to reconstitute it before using.

notes:
A very common cooking and daily-life expression. Soaking ingredients in water is a fundamental step in Japanese cooking.

COMMON USES IN COOKING:
- ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{水|みず}に{浸|ひた}す: soaking rice before cooking (typically 30 minutes to an hour)
- ⟦{豆|まめ}→豆：03738_mame⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{水|みず}に{浸|ひた}す: soaking dried beans
- ⟦{乾物|かんぶつ}→乾物：06191_kanbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{水|みず}に{浸|ひた}す: soaking dried goods (shiitake, kombu, etc.)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧につける: to put in water — very similar, slightly more casual
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漬|つ}ける→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧: to soak/pickle in water — can also mean marinating
- ⟦{浸|ひた}す→浸す：07506_hitasu⟧ alone means "to soak" or "to immerse" and can be used with liquids other than water

USAGE:
⟦{浸|ひた}す→浸す：07506_hitasu⟧ (transitive) vs. ⟦{浸|ひた}る→浸る：13339_hitaru⟧ (intransitive): ⟦{浸|ひた}す→浸す：07506_hitasu⟧ means to soak something; ⟦{浸|ひた}る→浸る：13339_hitaru⟧ means to be soaked or immersed.
